note: Adapted from the original description of Constantino 1990 (English, with a Portuguese abstract); the soldier and worker of the new species C. glaber are both fully described and measured; the alate is unknown (IMAGO — Unknown in the original). The same work gives only key characters and comparisons for caete and timuassu, without species-level descriptions.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier has no setae on the vertex and only 4 setae at the apex of the nasus; the ratio of nasus length to head length without the nasus is less than or equal to 1.0, and the head capsule is round in dorsal view, which distinguishes it from caete (ratio greater than 1.2, head capsule elongate in dorsal view) and timuassu (4 setae on the vertex, more setae at the apex of the nasus). The worker is monomorphic, the left mandible index about 1.7, and the enteric valve has 3 first-order and 3 second-order swellings, with about 30 fringe hairs on the first-order and about 20 on the second-order swellings.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule round in dorsal view, widest at the middle. Nasus conical. Labrum short and wide. Mandibles reduced, without points. Antennae 13-segmented: segment 1 the largest, segment 3 larger than segments 2, 4, 5 and 6, segment 4 the smallest, segment 5 larger than segment 2, segment 6 larger than segment 5, the following segments about equal in length. Anterior margin of the pronotum rounded, with a very shallow notch in the middle. Head capsule without hairs or setae. Apex of the nasus with 4 setae and a few very short hairs. Postmentum without setae. Anterior margin of the pronotum with numerous short hairs. Legs with scattered setae; tibiae with spines (about 10). Tibial spur formula 2:2:2. The last 4 abdominal tergites with scattered setae, the remaining segments without setae. Sternite surfaces with scattered setae, the posterior margin with a row of long setae. Head capsule yellow to orange-yellow; nasus rust orange, darker towards the apex; antennae orange; pronotum yellow; abdominal tergites and sternites pale yellow, transparent. Measurements of 10 soldiers: head length to the apex of the nasus 1.80—1.98, nasus length 0.86—0.99, head width 0.80—0.86, pronotum width 0.50—0.53, hind tibia length 1.18—1.23 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Monomorphic. Antennae 14-segmented. Postclypeus inflated. Head with scattered setae and some short hairs. Postclypeus with 4 setae. Labrum with 8 setae. Tergite and sternite surfaces with hairs and short setae; posterior margin of the sternites with a row of long setae. Head, pronotum and legs pale yellowish white, abdomen transparent. Mandibles as in fig. 9 and fig. 10, left mandible index about 1.7. Enteric valve well sclerotized, 3 first-order and 3 second-order swellings alternating, each with a sclerotized plate margin projecting into the valve lumen; on the plate margins the first-order swellings have about 30 spines and the second-order about 20.
